description: Projects in the catalogue, filtered by area, developer, bedrooms, maximum starting price in OMR, status or free text. Returns each project with its area, developer, status, starting price in OMR, bedrooms, handover and page URL. Sold-out projects are left out unless include_sold_out is true.

area.description: Area name or slug, e.g. "Al Mouj Muscat", "Jebel Sifah", "Hawana Salalah"

bedrooms.description: A home with this many bedrooms (0 = studio) must be in the project

developer.description: Developer name or slug, e.g. "Dar Global", "Muriya"

lang.description: Language of names and URLs. Default en.

limit.description: At most this many projects, default 10

max_price_omr.description: Highest starting price in Omani rial

query.description: Free text matched against project, area and developer names

residency.description: Only projects where a purchase can qualify for Oman residency

name: search_projects
title: Find new-build projects in Oman
